results.title: Haim
results.overview: Haunted by nightmares of her miserable future, Rima Haim, grappling with an unexpected pregnancy, becomes hostage to her own mind in a surreal dreamscape as she tries to overcome her anxiety and the pressures of impending motherhood.

results.title: Bukayo Saka: The Time Is Now
results.original_title: Bukayo Saka: The Time Is Now
results.overview: Two generations of Arsenal greats are brought together as Bukayo Saka joins club legend Thierry Henry for an unguarded look at what it takes to perform at the highest level. Saka and Henry reflect on pressure, resilience, and the joy that first drew them to the game, with the conversation taking them back to Saka’s childhood home in Ealing where it all began.

results.title: A Messy Tribute to Motherly Love
results.overview: When people literally explode from emotional overload, grief is just the beginning. A wildly surrealist charade in which a bereaved man, his friend and mother spiral through village life.

results.original_title: La Grande Histoire de la Marine

results.title: Best Friends with the Devil
results.overview: Lola searches for her missing best friend with the help of a stranger who may know more than he’s letting on.

results.title: You'll Be Fine
results.overview: A woman slowly realizes her husband may not be who she thinks. Shot in a single unbroken take.

results.title: Notice Me
results.overview: Two lesbian neighbors in London's East End navigate romance and connection through messy, heartfelt situations, going to ridiculous lengths to get closer to each other.

results.title: House of Death
results.overview: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

results.title: Trees are Watching
results.overview: Novelist Darya returns to her hometown with her deaf daughter to work on her new book. There she is haunted by the memory of twin girls from her childhood, and the two trees planted as their memorials.

results.title: The Debt Collectors Son
results.overview: A debt collector brings his son, an aspiring artist, along on a job in the hopes of making a man out of him.

results.title: Between Summers
results.overview: Between french fries, TikToks, and sunscreen, carefree moments clash with self-doubt, and playful freedom with societal pressure. This is the vibrant world of adolescents searching for their place – on the lawn and in life. When the orange slide is torn down, the chapter of childhood comes to an end. Two years later, after the renovation, it's not just the public pool that has changed.

results.title: Paper Plane
results.overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

results.title: Frost: The Story of a Lifetime
results.original_title: Frost: The Story of a Lifetime
results.overview: A tribute to Tom Frost, the visionary who redefined climbing style, the engineer who helped revolutionize climbing equipment, the artist whose iconic photography documented the most celebrated first ascents on Yosemite’s big walls, and the conservationist who lead the international effort to save historic Camp 4—the traditional home and meeting place for Yosemite climbers.

results.title: Starflyer
results.overview: Niki and Aurora meet on a winter night at Allou Fun Park, the biggest theme park in Athens. Soon they will discover that they come from the same world.

results.title: City of Fathers
results.overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

results.title: Target: Captain Black!
results.overview: Once, he was their most trusted agent. Now, they hunt him.

results.title: My Husband
results.overview: Otto bemoans the strife of loving (and loathing) his handsome spouse.

results.title: Living with a Visionary
results.overview: After 50 years of marriage, John must care for his wife while learning to live alongside her vivid hallucinations.

results.title: Acid City
results.overview: A dystopian future that’s ever nearer, Acid City floats in toxic waters and is left to its own devices. But under the boiling sun, the city weaves together its own social fabric. With audio recordings taken off the streets of NYC, this animation offers us something rare in the face of climate catastrophe: hope.
